_doc: Machine-readable exam format (structure only, no exam content). Counts/times checked against the official pages in verified.sources on verified.date; criteria descriptions are LexKite's own wording. Read by scripts/content-qa/exam-format-check.mjs (docs/CONTENT-QA.md §6).
name: TOEIC Speaking and Writing

sources: ETS TOEIC S&W sample tests (task rating scales)

tasks.name: Respond to questions using information provided
Write a sentence based on a picture
tasks.note: two given words/phrases must be used

tasks.name: Write an opinion essay
tasks.min_words_note: ETS: an effective essay typically has at least 300 words

scoring.method: task ratings combined and converted; speaking and writing reported separately

speaking.focus: Clear sounds, word stress and natural intonation so a listener understands without effort.
Grammar and vocabulary accurate enough and varied enough for the task.
Answer is relevant, complete and, for the opinion task, supported with reasons and examples.

writing.focus: Sentences are grammatical; picture sentences use both given words correctly.
Every request or question in the email or prompt is answered in an appropriate tone.
Essay states an opinion and develops it with organised reasons and examples.
Range and accuracy of vocabulary and sentence structure.
